audience: product and customer success teams that track NPS, CSAT and CES in SatisMeter

useCases.title: Report the NPS score for a period
useCases.text: List the surveys, then get the statistics of the NPS survey for a date window: displays, responses, response rate and answer counts.

useCases.title: Check which surveys are live
useCases.text: List every survey in the project with its type and state, such as live or draft. Get one survey for its name and type.

useCases.title: Read the answers of one survey
useCases.text: List the responses of one survey, page by page. Responses can include names and emails.

useCases.title: Read responses across all surveys
useCases.text: Check the project, then list the responses recorded in any survey within a date window. Responses can include names and emails.
